content: Compatibility between the AUTOSAR Templates Type: valid Description: The compatibility between the AUTOSAR Templates must be guaranteed. In this context, compatibility means that each AUTOSAR template can have references to elements of another AUTOSAR template. Rationale: Ensuring coherence and interoperability between AUTOSAR templates. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Development of an in-vehicle electronic architecture (software modelling, hardware modelling and mapping constraint modelling) using the same tool chain. Supporting Material: 
